title: kramastotra — kram-p01-v01
question: This is the completion-rite amid sorrow's host — in the spreading taste of great bliss-essence, this foul day: for by mutual doing, in the hymn of the Lord, weighty with scorching uneven flames, the mind constantly reflects back — its fear gone.
